useWhen: You want to test two versions of something
You need to validate a change before rolling out

workflow.description: State what you expect to happen and why
Let test run until statistical significance

examples.input: I want to test if moving the CTA button from the bottom of my landing page to above the fold will increase conversions
examples.output:
## A/B Test: CTA Button Placement

### Hypothesis
Moving the "Sign Up" CTA button above the fold will increase conversion rate by 20% because users won't have to scroll to take action.

---

### Test Design

**Control (A)**
- CTA button at bottom of page, after all content
- Current placement

**Treatment (B)**
- CTA button at top of page, in hero section
- Above the fold

---

### Traffic Split
- 50% Control / 50% Treatment
- Random assignment by session ID

---

### Success Metrics

**Primary:**
- Sign-up button clicks

**Secondary:**
- Time on page
- Bounce rate
- Scroll depth

---

### Sample Size & Duration
- **Baseline conversion:** 3%
- **Minimum detectable effect:** 20% relative (3.6%)
- **Statistical power:** 80%
- **Significance level:** 95%
- **Required sample:** 14,000 visitors
- **Estimated duration:** 7 days

---

### Implementation
- Use Google Optimize or VWO
- Track with Google Analytics
- Ensure no flash of unstyled content

---

### Decision Criteria
- If B > A by >20%: Ship B
- If B < A: Ship A (keep control)
- If inconclusive: Extend test or redesign
